text: Decision (using your go-ahead): I'm NOT removing PropLine, because you pay for Pro and its odds, closing lines (CLV) and grading feed the engine and my studies; only the +EV list is weak. Changes: (1) the +EV screen now shows only lines where Vigilant also shows +EV (chip to show all); (2) the engine sweeps it once an hour instead of every 15 min, and when you pull the screen down. The old pace used ~21,000 of the Pro key's 25,000 daily requests on a list Vigilant calls 0% or worse 94% of the time; the new pace uses ~5,000 and frees the rest for the data that does help. Ships in v0.114.23.
